hints.title: Tree Probability Tracking
hints.text: The frog starts at vertex 1 with probability 1.0. At each step, it chooses unvisited neighbors with uniform probability.

hints.title: Leaves and Stopping Conditions
hints.text: If the frog reaches target before time t and has nowhere else to jump, it stays at target with probability remaining unchanged.

hints.title: Exact Time vs Trapped Target
hints.text: Target must either be reached exactly at time t, or reached earlier with no unvisited neighbors left.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating random walks with Monte Carlo sampling is imprecise and slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since the graph is an undirected tree, there is a unique simple path from vertex 1 to target.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate calculates the product of branch choices along the path to target and validates boundary conditions.
